notes: «سمعت أبا عبد الله» names the Imam as the source (rule 5), so he is a link; «عليه السلام» is a blessing
inside the saying, Gabriel, the Prophet, Ali and the Angel of Death speak as characters; their words are not transmissions, so they are not links
the saying runs on through a second scene («وإذا حضر الكافر الوفاة») inside the same report, with no second chain
